original_test_intent: Sustain the approved Ethernet workload for eight hours and prove interval plus aggregate bandwidth remains within specification while the link, system and event logs remain healthy.
original_method: Run a provenance-checked iperf tool on a dedicated DUT/peer path for 28800 seconds with defined interval, direction, streams and rate, continuously collecting throughput, retransmits, counters and platform health, then clean up tracked processes.
manual_activity: User approves trusted tool, dedicated topology, workload, thresholds and maintenance/recovery; operator confirms cabling and independent access; agent runs only the tracked approved soak.
required_inputs: Approved iperf/iperf3 version, provenance/checksum/license and exact syntax
Eight-hour duration, 60-second or approved interval, direction, streams/rate
Bandwidth, retransmit, disconnect, CRC/link, thermal/power and event-log thresholds
Maintenance window, evidence capacity, independent management, recovery owner and invalid-run policy
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated non-management path and validate peer/tool compatibility
Track exact server/client PIDs and bound traffic/monitoring storage
Stop on throughput collapse, congestion, link/CRC errors, peer loss, thermal/power/system or evidence failure
Preserve baseline and continuous logs; do not clear events
Do not blind-download, broad-kill, reboot or automatically rerun
agent_execution_scope: Validate approved topology/tool and collect baseline
Launch tracked eight-hour Ethernet server/client and continuous monitoring
Compare intervals/aggregate with thresholds, stop tracked processes and verify restoration
Do not choose workload/thresholds, substitute IB, broad-kill, auto-recover or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve tool, workload, topology, limits and recovery
Review complete time-series evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Directionally relevant but non-executable because exact tool, peer, workload, thresholds, continuous evidence and tracked cleanup are missing and IB alternatives are out of scope.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the approved tracked Ethernet iperf server/client on the dedicated path for exactly 28800 seconds with defined reports and simultaneous full link/system monitoring.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SUT server, client peer, 60-second example reports, 28800-second/eight-hour stress, SPEC bandwidth and no-error/workable criteria plus 30/500 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a provenance-locked eight-hour Ethernet soak with tracked processes and complete interval-level network/system telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds reproducible workload, safe isolation, continuous acceptance data and deterministic cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Ethernet coverage remains distinct from IB stress and cannot be reduced to a final summary line.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Host CPU, TCP window, peer limits and competing traffic affect throughput; thresholds must reflect the approved topology rather than nominal link rate alone.

project_override_considerations: Project may approve iperf2 or iperf3, but the exact binary and semantics must be fixed; generic latest is not reproducible.
expected_evidence: Approval, tool provenance/version and exact command
Baseline throughput, counters and system health
Full eight-hour interval and aggregate throughput/retransmit/error output
Continuous link/CRC/counters, CPU/thermal/power and system/SEL events
Tracked PID/exit/cleanup, restoration, abort/recovery notes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master and GPT V2 clearly require Ethernet stress; DeepSeek's broad tool wording is incomplete but does not make the authoritative row ambiguous.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Project tool/topology/workload inputs are execution prerequisites, not a static-review block.

review_improvement: Makes the eight-hour Ethernet soak reproducible, continuously observable and safely recoverable without losing original duration or SPEC criteria.
independent_technical_reasoning: An aggregate bandwidth value can hide transient disconnects, retransmit bursts and thermal throttling. The eight-hour claim therefore requires interval-level traffic and health data time-aligned with link/error counters and event logs, plus proof that only the launched processes were stopped.
